correctness.rationale: The augmented Hopf trace sign is (-1)^{c-1} for c invariant vertex cycles; exact orbit-conflict graphs enumerate every invariant simplex for each of 15 \(S_7\) conjugacy classes. Exhaustive independent face enumeration and deletion-recurrence plus Murnaghan–Nakayama computations agree on all class values and all irreducible coefficients. The published \(\beta_6=29\) and \(\beta_9=7\) dimension theorem, plus rational semisimplicity, uniquely separates negative coefficients into \(H_9\) (1+6), leaving three positive constituents in \(H_6\) (1+14+14). No finite experimental extrapolation is used.
